text: dsh-quick-explain 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的选中文本解释插件。它在聊天界面检测选区，并通过 shell.overlay 显示解释入口和临时侧边面板；主机端提供独立 API 路由，使用 DSH 当前模型流式生成说明。用户可查看选中文字及周围段落的解释，并在侧边对话中继续提问。关闭面板或闲置一段时间后，临时对话会被清除。适合阅读聊天中的术语、代码片段或论述；需要 DSH 已配置可用模型。

dsh-quick-explain adds a selection-based explainer panel to DSH Web. It sends the selected chat text and nearby paragraph to the configured DSH model, then lets users ask follow-up questions in a temporary side conversation. The main session remains separate; an available DSH model is required.
想选中聊天里的一个词，单独问它是什么意思。
能不能解释一段对话内容，同时不把问题加进主会话？
I want to highlight a code snippet in chat and ask what it does.
dsh-quick-explain 的功能「选区解释」：在聊天内容中选中文字后显示解释入口，打开临时侧边对话，并把所选片段及附近段落交给 DSH 当前模型生成说明。
dsh-quick-explain 的功能「侧边追问」：用户可在临时面板继续提问，查看模型回复；关闭面板时结束线程，后台也会清理长期闲置的线程。
dsh-quick-explain 使用前须知：选中的片段、附近上下文和后续问题会通过 DSH 配置的模型发送给所选模型服务。

dsh-quick-explain README · Introduction：`dsh-quick-explain` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin: highlight a word or a sentence in any message, click **💡 Explain**, and a temporary side conversation opens on the right. It explains the fragment, answers follow-ups, and disappears when you close it — the main chat keeps its exact history and context.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-quick-explain README · Why：Sometimes you need to understand one word, one acronym, or one sentence in the middle of a long task. Asking the main assistant means adding a turn you will have to live with: it enters the session log, the model's context, and every later request. This plugin gives you a separate, disposable explainer instead.

dsh-quick-explain README · Features：- **Selection → aside.** Highlight 1–1200 characters in the transcript; a small chip appears next to the selection.
- **Explains in place.** The side panel streams a short explanation of the selected text, using the paragraph around it as context.
- **Follow-up questions.** Keep digging in the panel; each question stays in the side conversation.
- **Zero impact on the main session.** Nothing is appended to the session log, no message is added to the conversation, and the main model request is untouched.
- **Uses your own model.** The side calls go through DSH's own `ctx.llm.stream` with your configured default model.
- **Native chrome.** The panel is a right-edge sheet built from DSH's own theme tokens — same hairlines, radii, type scale and motion — so it reads as part of the app instead of a third-party card.
- **Disposable by design.** Closing the panel, or 30 minutes of inactivity, drops the side conversation from host memory.
- **Local only.** The panel talks to a route inside your running DSH process; no extra service, no telemetry.

dsh-quick-explain README · Install：In DSH Desktop: open the **Plugins** page (sidebar, or Settings → Plugins) → **Add plugin**:

1. In **Package name or address**, enter `dsh-quick-explain`.
2. Select **Install**, then **Enable now**. If DSH says the change takes effect at the next start, quit DSH completely and open it again.

If npm is not reachable, you can instead enter the full path of a `.tgz` (`npm pack dsh-quick-explain`), or `github:JujiuYey/dsh-quick-explain`.

dsh-quick-explain README · Usage：1. Select text in a message.
2. Click **💡 Explain** next to the selection.
3. Read the explanation; type a follow-up and press `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter`.
4. Close with `×` or `Esc` — the side chat is discarded.

dsh-quick-explain README · How it works：```text
selection
   │  client.js: start(quote, context)
   ▼
POST /api/quick-explain            (plugin-owned route, same origin)

The main conversation's Session is not part of this path. The side conversation never emits session events, so it cannot affect replay, compaction, or the next model request.

dsh-quick-explain README · Files：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: the `/api/quick-explain` route, in-memory threads, model calls, idle sweep |
| `client.js` | Client half: selection detection, floating chip, side panel, polling |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the profile |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin list title and description (English / Chinese) |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |

dsh-quick-explain README · Development：Install this directory as a **Local directory** bundle, edit, then restart DSH to load changed client code:

```sh
npm pack            # produces dsh-quick-explain-<version>.tgz
```

or point the plugin manager at the checkout. The Host half (`index.js`) is plain ESM with no build step; the Client half (`client.js`) is a plain script that registers a lazy factory with `window.__ModuleLoader__`.

dsh-quick-explain README · Development：Requirements: DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or a compatible release that provides `ctx.connection.fetch`, `ctx.llm`, `ctx.agentDefaultModel`, and the `shell.overlay` client slot.

dsh-quick-explain README · Privacy：The selected text, the paragraph around it, and your follow-up questions are sent to the model provider configured in DSH — the same provider your main conversation already uses. The side conversation itself lives only in the Host process memory: it is not written to the session log, not stored on disk, and gone after a restart.

dsh-quick-explain README · Limitations：- The explainer sees the selection plus its surrounding paragraph, not the full conversation history — that is the price of leaving the main session untouched.
- Answers render light inline Markdown (`**bold**` and `` `code` ``); headings and lists are not interpreted.
- Side conversations are per-process; restarting DSH clears them.
- UI strings are English and Chinese only.

dsh-quick-explain README · Development：The client is bundled from `src/` into a single injected script:

```sh
npm install   # also runs the build via `prepare`
npm run build # regenerate client.js
```
